appraisal_events.evidence: après ces valets de pied en livrée, pareils aux figurants dont le cortège...diminue l'apparition finale de la reine, Mme Swann entrant furtivement en petit paletot de loutre...ne tenait pas les promesses prodiguées dans l'attente à mon imagination.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's inflated anticipation, built up by the procession of footmen, is explicitly deflated by Mme Swann's ordinary, furtive actual entrance, staged through the narrator's own theatre-queen metaphor of diminishment.

appraisal_events.evidence: Swann supprima brusquement pour moi une de ces affreuses distances intérieures...j'éprouvai pour lui une tendresse que je crus plus profonde que ma tendresse pour Gilberte. Car maître de sa fille, il me la donnait et elle, elle se refusait parfois.
appraisal_events.explanation: Swann's generous promise to grant the narrator access to Gilberte's private world elevates him in the narrator's affections beyond Gilberte herself, since Swann freely gives what Gilberte sometimes withholds.

status_effects.explanation: The reality of Mme Swann's entrance falls short of the grandeur the narrator's imagination had built up, locally deflating her image.
Swann's indulgent, distance-dissolving gesture wins him an outsized tenderness from the narrator, momentarily surpassing the narrator's feeling for Gilberte herself.
By explicit comparison, the narrator finds he has more indirect power over Gilberte through Swann's mediation than directly through her, since she sometimes refuses him.
